subject.title: fix(onboarding): harden fresh local startup and activation

question: After the changelog edit is removed and exact-head checks complete, should the combined onboarding fix land with the new managed-Gateway repair semantics?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes startup and recovery behavior at the macOS process-owner availability boundary, so maintainers must explicitly own that rollout even though the implementation and live proof are convincing.

options.title: Land after final gates
options.body: Accept the combined lifecycle and inference-publication fix after removing the changelog edit and confirming all required exact-head checks.

options.title: Split the rollout
options.body: Separate inference publication from the macOS lifecycle changes to provide independent review and rollback boundaries.

options.title: Pause lifecycle changes
options.body: Land only the activation publication work and defer managed-Gateway repair policy to a narrower follow-up.

recommendation.title: Land after final gates
recommendation.body: Accept the combined lifecycle and inference-publication fix after removing the changelog edit and confirming all required exact-head checks.
